parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Provides supplementary information about the security group rule. The value is a string of no more than 255 characters that can contain letters and digits.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Specifies the direction of access control. The value can be egress or ingress.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

parameters.name: ethertype
parameters.description: Specifies the IP protocol version. The value can be IPv4 or IPv6. If you do not set this parameter, IPv4 is used by default.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

parameters.name: port_range_max
parameters.description: Specifies the end port number. The value ranges from 1 to 65535. If the protocol is not icmp, the value cannot be smaller than the port_range_min value. An empty value indicates all ports.

parameters.name: port_range_min
parameters.description: Specifies the start port number. The value ranges from 1 to 65535. The value cannot be greater than the port_range_max value. An empty value indicates all ports.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Specifies the protocol type. The value can be icmp, tcp, or udp. If the parameter is left blank, the security group supports all protocols.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to which the project belongs.

parameters.name: remote_group_id
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the peer security group. The value is exclusive with parameter remote_ip_prefix.

parameters.name: remote_ip_prefix
parameters.description: Specifies the remote IP address. If the access control direction is set to egress, the parameter specifies the source IP address. If the access control direction is set to ingress, the parameter specifies the destination IP address. The value can be in the CIDR format or IP addresses. The parameter is exclusive with parameter remote_group_id.

parameters.name: security_group_id
parameters.description: Specifies the security group rule ID, which uniquely identifies the security group rule.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

examples:
# create a security group rule
- name: Create a security group
  hwc_vpc_security_group:
    name: "ansible_network_security_group_test"
  register: sg
- name: Create a security group rule
  community.general.hwc_vpc_security_group_rule:
    direction: "ingress"
    protocol: "tcp"
    ethertype: "IPv4"
    port_range_max: 22
    security_group_id: "{{ sg.id }}"
    port_range_min: 22
    remote_ip_prefix: "0.0.0.0/0"

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: Provides supplementary information about the security group rule. The value is a string of no more than 255 characters that can contain letters and digits. Returned: success

return_values.name: direction
return_values.description: Specifies the direction of access control. The value can be egress or ingress. Returned: success

return_values.name: ethertype

return_values.name: port_range_max

return_values.name: port_range_min
return_values.description: Specifies the start port number. The value ranges from 1 to 65535. The value cannot be greater than the port_range_max value. An empty value indicates all ports. Returned: success

return_values.name: protocol

return_values.name: remote_group_id

return_values.name: remote_ip_prefix

If the access control direction is set to ingress, the parameter specifies the destination IP address. The value can be in the CIDR format or IP addresses. The parameter is exclusive with parameter remote_group_id. Returned: success

return_values.name: security_group_id
